text:
maya: BetaCorp's security team requested POC artifacts for their questionnaire: API key TTL, rotation logs, audit export format (must include model+caller), and a signed attestation. Can we pull together a one-off evidence bundle?
jon: short answers: hosted eval keys default 12h (can be reduced), Dedicated uses service-account creds + RBAC, Private supports customer KMS/HSM (partner option, longer lead).
ricardo: Evidence we can produce: daily audit JSONL (fields: timestamp, request_id, model_id, principal_id, action, tokens, region), signed SHA256 snapshot per-day, rotation_events.csv (key_id, rotated_by, timestamp, fingerprint), and a KMS manifest (key_arn + policy snapshot). We can stream events to Splunk HEC or push to S3.
rachel (BetaCorp): Can you confirm we can stream to our Splunk HEC with near-real-time ingestion? Also need an example log line to map fields.
maya: Yes. We need HEC endpoint, HEC token (we store encrypted), and CIDR allowlist. We provide a small setup checklist and config sample.
jon: example line: {"timestamp":"2026-04-12T11:05:22Z","request_id":"r-7f1a","model_id":"rdw-3","principal_id":"svc/betacorp-poc","action":"generate","tokens":98,"region":"us-east-1"}
ricardo: rotation cadence: default monthly for control-plane keys on Dedicated; we record who rotated and when. For POC we typically keep audit exports 90 days unless customer asks longer. We can sign rotation_events.csv and include signature files.
infra-bot: provisioner: created temporary export role for betacorp-poc, expires in 11 days (role: rl-df12).
maya: I'll assemble: attestation PDF, example JSONL, signed daily snapshot, rotation_events.csv, and KMS manifest. Jon/ Ricardo please review retention wording before I send.
jon: I approve 90-day default retention for POCs. Add note: longer retention requires SOW.
rachel (BetaCorp): Great, can we schedule a quick call tomorrow to validate HEC and whitelisting?
maya: Invite sent for 09:30 PT. Attestation draft: "Redwood Inference provides audit logs containing request_id, model_id, principal_id, action, and timestamp. Logs can be exported to customer-managed S3 or streamed to customer Splunk HEC over TLS. For Dedicated and Private deployments, control-plane keys rotate monthly by default; customer-managed KMS is supported. Default POC audit export retention is 90 days unless otherwise agreed."
ricardo: I'll add the S3 path and KMS ARN placeholders and sign the CSV before we send. Thanks :thumbsup:
